interface.longDescription: Explore angles, transformations and growth. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Inspect an angle; Transform y = a(x − h)² + k; Model repeated growth. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me transform y = a(x − h)² + k.

prompts: Help me transform y = a(x − h)² + k.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Arcwise: Precalculus workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me inspect an angle with these supplied values: {"degrees":135}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses precalculus_lab_trig_values with the supplied inputs. Returns {"degrees":135,"radians":2.3562,"sin":0.7071,"cos":-0.7071,"tan":-1,"point":{"x":-0.7071,"y":0.7071}}. Shows the actual unit-circle result. Does not fabricate external data.
